Findings.problem: The capacity bound defensively casts every numeric operand to int although ghost comparisons and mixed mathematical arithmetic coerce them.
Findings.key_premise: The casts in this bound are arithmetic/comparison operands, not int-typed function arguments or standalone divisors.
Findings.suggestion: Drop the redundant as int casts in this bound and analogous comparisons, keeping casts needed for int parameters and narrowing results; confirm with the historical verifier when available.

Findings.problem: Representation helpers count_set_bits_prefix, count_set_bits, full_set_word and bit_at are pub open even though the available tree uses them only in this module.
Findings.key_premise: All word-level helper references are in cpu/set.rs, and they expose the backing bit layout rather than the set view.
Findings.suggestion: Make representation-only helpers private closed spec functions; keep the public set model and caller-provable requirements usable through their intended API.

Findings.problem: Private bit-manipulation and bounds lemmas precede the public CpuSet API and split the model declarations.
Findings.key_premise: lemma_bit_at_uniform and the following nonzero-bit helpers discharge representation side obligations; constructors begin at line 350.
Findings.suggestion: Move auxiliary proofs to a clearly marked trailing verus block, keeping View, Inv, and executable APIs first.

Findings.problem: This wrapper proof has one caller and only forwards the argument to the recursive auxiliary proof after one assertion.
Findings.key_premise: lemma_u64_nonzero_has_set_bit is called once, from is_empty; its recursive auxiliary has no independent consumer.
Findings.suggestion: Inline the wrapper at is_empty and nest the recursive proof helper there, unless verification demonstrates a necessary separate context boundary.

Findings.problem: contains retains an unused ret binder despite expressing its exact result with returns; is_empty repeats this pattern and exact closure results use ensures.
Findings.key_premise: The contains contract does not reference ret.
Findings.suggestion: Remove unused ret binders and use returns for exact closure results where the declared types match.
